newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis International Bank H1 net profit up 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunis International Bank H1 net profit up 23 pct.

text.p: Tunis International Bank TIB, a privately owned offshore bank, said on Wednesday that it posted a $625,000 net profit during the first half of 1996, a rise of 23 percent from $506,552 in the same period last year.
The bank said that its clients' deposits were up by 10 percent during the first half of 1996, compared to the same period in 1995.
TIB posted a $1.007 million net profit in 1995, 21 percent It raised it's capital from $15 million to $20 million last year.

The Tunis-based bank, which in 1982 became the first offshore bank to be established in Tunisia, has Middle East banking and financial institutions and Tunisian private investors among its shareholders.
